name: Haas Widener
author: Motion Audio
description: Width from timing: one side a few milliseconds later, so a mono sound spreads out. A low cut keeps the bass centred and mono-safe.
code:
delay d[40]
@sample
m = (inL + inR) * 0.5
k = 1 - exp(-2 * pi * bass / srate)
lo += (m - lo) * k + 1e-20
d.write(inR * (side > 0.5 ? 1 : 0) + inL * (side > 0.5 ? 0 : 1))
w = d.read(time)
hiL = inL - lo
hiR = inR - lo
if (side > 0.5) { outL = lo + hiL; outR = lo + mix(hiR, w - lo, amount) } else { outL = lo + mix(hiL, w - lo, amount); outR = lo + hiR }
